name: Captionary v1.0.0 — Offline AI Speech Studio
body:
### What's New in Captionary v1.0.0

- **100% On-Device AI Captioning:** Whisper AI transcription running natively on your Android device with zero cloud audio uploads.
- **Studio & Subtitle Stylization:** Timeline editing, customizable ASS/SRT subtitles, TikTok Bold & IG Highlight presets, and real-time preview.
- **Direct Video Burn-in:** Hardware-accelerated video export with styled subtitles directly embedded.
- **Multi-language Support:** Downloadable offline language packs cached locally from R2.
- **RAM & Performance Protection:** Dynamic memory tiering and safety guards protecting devices from OOM errors.
